chunks: O Prophet, fear God and do not follow the unbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, God was All-Knowing, All-Wise.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command the Prophet to do regarding disbelievers and hypocrites?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing the Prophet generally but with specific emphasis on his role as the ultimate model of taqwa, distinguishing his spiritual authority from the political maneuvering of the Quraysh and the Hypocrites (Munafiqun). The command to 'not follow' them highlights the necessity of maintaining doctrinal and practical independence from opposing forces, a principle that extends to the Imams who inherit this prophetic mantle. This directive underscores the divine wisdom (hikmah) in guiding the community through periods of internal strife and external pressure.
